# Plan

The same two CDFs as `06_cdf_eif3d_targets_ribo_te.Rmd`, with the gene sets taken from
**MCF7-SIX1, si3d, hypoxia 1hr** instead of MDA-MB-231.

**Groups.**

- **eIF3d-promoted** (orange): `mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv`, intersected
  with the MCF7-SIX1 feature matrix. TE > 0.5 and padj < 0.05, promotes-positive (negated from
  the source's log2(si3d / sictrl) by `10m_mcf7six1_outcome_prep.Rmd`).
- **Negative control** (black): a size-matched `set.seed(9)` draw from
  `mcf7six1_3d_negative_controls_lfc0.5.csv` (|TE| < 0.5 and padj > 0.3 in both hypoxia and
  normoxia), using the same procedure as notebook 07's `create_target`: pool intersected with
  the matrix, positives removed, `sample(pool, n_positives)`. No MCF7-SIX1 classifier draw was
  ever saved, so this draw is **re-made, not reproduced**.
- **All other genes** (grey): every other gene in the Liu results.

**Readouts** from `05_riboseq_deseq2.Rmd`, log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), positive = METTL13
promotes: **(A)** ribo LFC as saved (shrunken), **(B)** TE LFC unshrunken (noisy, because the
Liu RNA arm does not replicate).

# Load the Liu ribo-seq results

```{r load_liu}
liu_csv <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2",
                "translation_categories_sgcontrol_vs_sgmettl13_liu2026.csv")
if (!file.exists(liu_csv)) stop("Run 05_riboseq_deseq2.Rmd first: ", liu_csv, " not found")
liu <- read_csv(liu_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("gene_id", "ribo_lfc", "te_lfc_mle") %in% names(liu)), !anyDuplicated(liu$gene_id),
          all(is.finite(liu$ribo_lfc)), all(is.finite(liu$te_lfc_mle)),
          "METTL13 ribo_lfc not positive - Liu contrast direction flipped" =
            liu$ribo_lfc[liu$gene_id == "METTL13"] > 1)
cat("Liu genes:", nrow(liu), "\n")
```

# MCF7-SIX1 gene sets

```{r load_sets}
pos_csv <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
neg_csv <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "mcf7six1_3d_negative_controls_lfc0.5.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
matrix_genes <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview",
                             "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds"))$gene_id_clean
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(matrix_genes), !anyDuplicated(pos_csv$ensembl_gene),
          !anyDuplicated(neg_csv$ensembl_gene))
```

## Check: direction and definitions

The MCF7-SIX1 source is log2(si3d / sictrl), the opposite of MDA-MB-231; the gene-set file
stores the negated, promotes-positive value. Its membership must be exactly te_lfc > 0.5 and
padj < 0.05 in `10m_`'s promotes-positive table, where the negation was verified with three
independent rulers.

```{r direction}
mcf7_te <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
expected_pos <- mcf7_te %>% filter(te_lfc > 0.5, !is.na(te_padj), te_padj < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id_clean)

stopifnot(
  "gene set is not te_lfc > 0.5 & padj < 0.05 in the promotes-positive table" =
    setequal(expected_pos, pos_csv$ensembl_gene),
  "gene set should be labelled promotes-positive" =
    all(grepl("promotes-positive", pos_csv$gs_description)),
  all(pos_csv$te_lfc > 0.5), all(pos_csv$te_padj < 0.05),
  all(abs(neg_csv$te_lfc) < 0.5), all(neg_csv$te_padj > 0.3),
  length(intersect(pos_csv$ensembl_gene, neg_csv$ensembl_gene)) == 0
)
cat("Promoted:", nrow(pos_csv), "| negative pool:", nrow(neg_csv), "\n")
```

## Size-matched negative draw

```{r draw}
pos_in <- pos_csv %>% filter(ensembl_gene %in% matrix_genes)
pool   <- neg_csv %>% filter(ensembl_gene %in% matrix_genes, !ensembl_gene %in% pos_in$ensembl_gene)
stopifnot("negative pool not larger than the positive set" = nrow(pool) > nrow(pos_in))

set.seed(params$neg_seed)
neg_draw <- sample(pool$ensembl_gene, nrow(pos_in))

cat("Positives in matrix:", nrow(pos_in), "of", nrow(pos_csv),
    "| pool in matrix minus positives:", nrow(pool),
    "| drawn:", length(neg_draw), "\n")
stopifnot(length(neg_draw) == nrow(pos_in), !anyDuplicated(neg_draw))
```

# Match set genes to Liu genes

On symbol, as in `06_`. Liu's genes are RefSeq symbols; the MCF7-SIX1 sets carry GENCODE
symbols. A gene symbol that appears twice in the negative pool is not drawn here, but the
check below guards it.

```{r match}
sets <- bind_rows(
  pos_in %>% transmute(gene_id_clean = ensembl_gene, symbol = db_gene_symbol, group = "eIF3d-promoted"),
  neg_csv %>% filter(ensembl_gene %in% neg_draw) %>%
    transmute(gene_id_clean = ensembl_gene, symbol = db_gene_symbol, group = "Negative control"))
stopifnot(nrow(sets) == 2 * nrow(pos_in), !anyNA(sets$symbol), !anyDuplicated(sets$symbol))

raw_genes <- read.delim(here("accessories", "liu2026_GSE335287_raw_counts.txt"))$geneID
sets %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_set = n(),
            in_liu_results    = sum(symbol %in% liu$gene_id),
            removed_by_filter = sum(symbol %in% raw_genes & !symbol %in% liu$gene_id),
            absent_from_file  = sum(!symbol %in% raw_genes),
            fraction_in_liu   = mean(symbol %in% liu$gene_id)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

matched <- sets %>% filter(symbol %in% liu$gene_id) %>% dplyr::rename(liu_gene = symbol)
```

# CDFs

```{r cdf_function}
grp_levels <- c("eIF3d-promoted", "Negative control", "All other genes")
grp_colors <- c("eIF3d-promoted" = "#E69F00", "Negative control" = "black",
                "All other genes" = "grey70")

plot_df <- liu %>%
  left_join(matched %>% dplyr::select(liu_gene, group), by = c("gene_id" = "liu_gene")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(replace_na(group, "All other genes"), levels = grp_levels))

cdf_plot <- function(col, xlab, title) {
  x  <- split(plot_df[[col]], plot_df$group)
  n  <- lengths(x)[grp_levels]
  w  <- list(pn = wilcox.test(x[["eIF3d-promoted"]],   x[["Negative control"]]),
             po = wilcox.test(x[["eIF3d-promoted"]],   x[["All other genes"]]),
             no = wilcox.test(x[["Negative control"]], x[["All other genes"]]))
  labs_n <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", grp_levels, trimws(format(n, big.mark = ","))), grp_levels)
  stats <- tibble(comparison = c("promoted vs neg ctrl", "promoted vs other", "neg ctrl vs other"),
                  wilcoxon_p = map_dbl(w, "p.value"))
  meds  <- map_dbl(x, median)[grp_levels]

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(.data[[col]], colour = group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = quantile(plot_df[[col]], c(0.005, 0.995))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_colors, labels = labs_n, breaks = grp_levels, name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.6, size = 3.2,
             label = sprintf("promoted vs neg ctrl: Wilcoxon p = %s\nmedian %.3f vs %.3f",
                             format.pval(w$pn$p.value, digits = 2),
                             meds[["eIF3d-promoted"]], meds[["Negative control"]])) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Cumulative fraction", title = title,
         subtitle = "Groups: eIF3d TE, MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
          legend.background = element_blank())
  list(plot = p, stats = stats, medians = meds)
}
```

## (A) Ribo LFC (shrunken, as saved)

```{r cdf_ribo, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cdf_ribo <- cdf_plot("ribo_lfc",
                     "Ribo log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), positive = METTL13 promotes",
                     "METTL13 KO ribosome occupancy (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
cdf_ribo$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_ribo$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_ribo$medians, "group", "median_ribo_lfc"), digits = 3)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_07_cdf_ribo_mcf7six1_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"), cdf_ribo$plot,
         width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

## (B) TE LFC (unshrunken)

```{r cdf_te, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cdf_te <- cdf_plot("te_lfc_mle",
                   "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), unshrunken; positive = METTL13 promotes",
                   "METTL13 KO TE (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
cdf_te$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_te$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_te$medians, "group", "median_te_lfc_mle"), digits = 3)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_07_cdf_te_unshrunken_mcf7six1_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"),
         cdf_te$plot, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

## (C) TE LFC (shrunken, as saved)

apeglm shrinks the TE LFC to ~0 for nearly every gene (the Liu RNA arm does not replicate), so
nearly every gene sits within about +/-5e-6. The axis is zoomed to that range; these
differences are far too small to mean anything biologically. Shown for comparison with (B).

```{r cdf_te_shrunken, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
cat("Genes with |shrunken TE LFC| < 0.01:", sum(abs(plot_df$te_lfc) < 0.01), "of", nrow(plot_df), "\n")
cdf_te_shr <- cdf_plot("te_lfc",
                       "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), shrunken; positive = METTL13 promotes",
                       "METTL13 KO TE, shrunken (Liu 2026, T3M4)")
# Shrunken values sit within about +/-5e-6 (99% of genes); zoom there, axis in units of 1e-6
cdf_te_shr$plot <- cdf_te_shr$plot +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-6e-6, 6e-6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) x * 1e6) +
  labs(x = "TE log2(sgControl / sgMETTL13), shrunken, x 1e-6\npositive = METTL13 promotes")
cdf_te_shr$plot
knitr::kable(cdf_te_shr$stats, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(enframe(cdf_te_shr$medians, "group", "median_te_lfc_shrunken"), digits = 5)

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_07_cdf_te_shrunken_mcf7six1_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"), cdf_te_shr$plot, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```
